title: 第21章 县太爷的拜帖
content_zh:
魏乐府从大宣武皇帝处得到了不少的情报，真假暂且不提，言语之间是真会收拢人心。

    反倒是那位萧氏瑶章公子，在他的情报帖下回了谢谢之后，就没有一点实质性的利益输出。

    如果后续还是这种态度，那魏乐府不考虑任何合作或者情报输出了。

    说难听，以他们的能力，七天时间怎么可能一点情报都没有。

    无非就是不想分享出来而已，藏拙很正常，魏乐府他也藏，但不能只想着占别人便宜。

    刚开始的时候，对方第一时间回复谢谢，魏乐府还是很有好感的，然后就被败光了。

    大宣武皇帝在魏乐府开了情报帖后，也紧跟着开了情报帖共享情报。

    就剩下萧氏瑶章公子纯口头感谢。

    魏乐府则是在寻找反馈按钮，看看能不能形成小团体或者是私聊功能。

    大家都不认识，第一次无偿分享的话有正面回馈，魏乐府自然不会小气吧啦。

    可既然无法获得有效价值，那肯定是以利益为重了。

    只是摸索了一番后，压根就没找到对应内容。

    对此，魏乐府也只能暂时作罢，估计得等以后吧。

    毕竟各方面都非常的简陋，能做出个交流平台，世界都已经非常尽力了。

    而且天涯阁这个交流平台还是依仗着灵脉这件天地奇物，不然就会没电没网。

    都拉成这德性了，魏乐府还能说什么。

    “老袁，吩咐后厨，烧一桌灵宴。”魏乐府直接吩咐手底下的人给自己去做饭。

    所谓灵宴，其实就是魏乐府打出来的噱头，就是酒菜、主食等等都是用含有灵气的食材烹饪出来。

    魏乐府虽然不懂营销，但是他也是刷过不少营销号，无非就是吹呗。

    “是，老爷。”作为跟了魏乐府多年的管事袁敬亭也是第一时间应声。

    “对了，还有一件事。”袁敬亭赶忙说道：“县太爷给老爷您递了拜帖，您看怎么安排回帖？”

    魏乐府听到这话，却是眉头一皱地问道：“这不年不节的，拜访我做什么？”

    平日里倒也不是没有官员来拜见他，县令只是正七品官，而魏乐府的员外兼司农寺丞虽属虚职，却比县令级别高。
content_en:
Wei Yuefu got a lot of information from Emperor Xuanwu. Putting aside the truth or falsehood, words can really win people's hearts.

    On the contrary, Young Master Yaozhang of the Xiao family did not export any substantial benefits after replying thank you to his information post.

    If this attitude remains the same in the future, then Wei Yuefu will not consider any cooperation or intelligence output.

    It's hard to say, given their abilities, how could they not have any information in seven days.

    It's just that he doesn't want to share it. It's normal to hide his clumsiness. Wei Yuefu also hides it, but he can't just think about taking advantage of others.

    At the beginning, the other party replied thank you immediately, and Wei Yuefu still had a good impression, but then he was completely defeated.

    After Emperor Xuanwu opened an intelligence post in Wei Yuefu, he also opened an intelligence post to share information.

    Only Young Master Yaozhang of the Xiao family was left to express his gratitude verbally.

    Wei Yuefu is looking for a feedback button to see if it can form small groups or private chat functions.

    No one knows anyone. If it is the first time to share for free and there is positive feedback, Wei Yuefu will naturally not be stingy.

    But since it is impossible to obtain effective value, it must be based on interests.

    After some searching, I couldn't find the corresponding content at all.

    In this regard, Wei Yuefu can only give up temporarily and probably have to wait until later.

    After all, it is very crude in every aspect, and the world has done its best to create a communication platform.

    Moreover, the communication platform of Tianya Pavilion still relies on the spiritual pulse, a rare thing in the world, otherwise there will be no power or network.

    Having become so virtuous, what else can Wei Yuefu say.

    "Lao Yuan, tell the chef to cook a spiritual banquet." Wei Yuefu directly ordered his subordinates to cook for him.

    The so-called spiritual banquet is actually a gimmick created by Wei Yuefu. The wine, dishes, staple food, etc. are all cooked with ingredients containing spiritual energy.

    Although Wei Yuefu doesn't understand marketing, he has used many marketing accounts, which is nothing more than blowing.

    "Yes, sir." Yuan Jingting, a steward who has been with Wei Yuefu for many years, also responded immediately.

    "By the way, there is one more thing." Yuan Jingting hurriedly said: "The county magistrate has handed you a greeting card. How do you think you can arrange a reply?"

    When Wei Yuefu heard this, he frowned and asked, "What are you doing here, why are you visiting me?"

    It is not that there are no officials who come to see him on weekdays. The county magistrate is only a seventh-rank official, and the Wei Yue Mansion's minister and Sinong Temple Cheng, although his position is meritless, is higher than the county magistrate.
